thread:
riley_ops: Heads-up: KIX-hub received 16 H100s from VegaCorp. 6 failing initial POST. Vendor proposes 4 air-replace to NRT-depot and 2 sea-return. Need decision on expedite share + routing. @sam_procurement @bianca_logistics

sam_procurement: Ask for serials, DOA photos, and a line-item air quote. Also confirm whether vendor will declare value and who covers duties if we expedite. Which ledger to charge? infra-capex or ops-expense?

bianca_logistics: If air, route to NRT-depot-1 for same-day swap. Depot demands manifest_v2 CSV + 12h pre-alert. No crossdock. Carrier options: NH or SQ. ETA 36h after AWB.

chen_platform: Cluster note: JP region Dedicated pool = 90 H100s. Losing 6 impacts scheduling; recommend spinning 2 hot-spares in JP for 48h if we go air. Cost est $900/day. Approve?

riley_ops: Vendor message: failures = "no POST" with PSU error trace. Serials (redacted): H100-VC-301..H100-VC-306. Air quote = $15,600 + customs. Vendor requests 45% expedite split and wants us to handle customs.

sam_procurement: 45% is too high. Counter 25% if vendor covers customs and provides carrier invoice. Require signed DOA + timestamped photos before paying expedite. Also need carrier cost breakout (surcharge, fuel, handling).

bianca_logistics: Pre-alert CSV example:

```
AWB,Carrier,ShipFrom,ShipTo,ItemCount,Serials,HSCode,RMA_type
TBD,TBD,VegaCorp,NRT-depot-1,4,"H100-VC-301;H100-VC-302;H100-VC-303;H100-VC-304",84733000,swap
```

Depot will reject shipments without this format.

chen_platform: If vendor signs counter, proceed with air and I'll reserve 2 hot-spares. If vendor refuses, choose sea-return and schedule depot repair which is ~10 business days.

riley_ops: Uploaded vendor photos and initial runlogs: https://files.redwood.internal/rma/3495000001/ (placeholder). Vendor replied: "can accept 30% if Redwood issues AWB within 4h." They also want us to sign a PO addendum approving expedite.

sam_procurement: Counter-offer: 30% expedite if vendor covers customs + provides carrier receipts and DOA form within 6h. No PO addendum until legal approves terms. Tagging legal in parallel.

notify_bot: Reminder set — follow up with VegaCorp in 4h if AWB not provided.

bianca_logistics: Action items:
1) riley_ops - confirm full serial manifest + ensure DOA photos are timestamped by 14:00 JST.
2) sam_procurement - draft PO addendum with 30% counter and require receipts + vendor to cover customs.
3) bianca_logistics - provision NRT-depot-1 slot conditional on AWB and manifest_v2.
4) chen_platform - reserve 2 hot-spares for 48h if AWB issued.

sam_procurement: If VegaCorp refuses carrier receipts or customs coverage, escalate to finance. We'll avoid >30% expedite without documentation. :thinking:

riley_ops: On it. Chasing vendor now.

End of thread.
